facts.text: Gina opened an online clothes store, which she described as a combination of her passion for fashion trends and her love for dance.

evidence.quote: My online clothes store is open! I've been dreaming of this for a while now - can't wait to see what happens!
I'm passionate about fashion trends and finding unique pieces. Plus, I wanted to blend my love for dance and fashion, so it was a perfect match.

facts.text: Gina previously worked at Door Dash and lost her job, which led to financial difficulties.

evidence.quote: Since I lost my job at Door Dash, things have been tough.

facts.text: Jon expressed excitement and support for Gina's new online store, calling it 'super cool' and offering best wishes.

evidence.quote: Combining your two interests into a store is super cool. Best of luck with it!
